title: The value of lambda(4): a machine-derived proof completing Mercer's Section-5 program (Chowla's cosine problem, finite front)
description: A machine-derived proof that lambda(4) = -L(1,2,3,4): the third exact value of Chowla's cosine dip (the finite front of Erdős problem #510), conjectured by Idris Mercer in INTEGERS 19 (2019) #A4 (arXiv:1709.06612) alongside a reduction strategy he wrote he could not execute. This repository executes and completes the strategy mechanically: the fourteen exceptional families of Mercer's Section 5 are re-derived symbolically (five are shown to close themselves), the remaining nine are each closed by second-level weight arguments on equispaced sets with thresholds derived rather than transcribed, and 2,231 finite cases are decided in exact rational arithmetic. Exactly, lambda(4) is the root of 512y^3 - 1227y^2 + 600y + 125 in a certified enclosure near 1.5195578816428; the cubic (apparently never printed before) is computed by exact resultant. The archive includes: the full campaign record (certs/lambda4-campaign.json), an independent adversarial audit sharing no code with the proving engine (25,819 gcd-reduced sets walked, every one reached by an explicit clause of the proof, zero holes, zero refuters), a battery that re-derives Mercer's published lambda(2) and lambda(3) proofs from scratch at every run, and a referee-grade prose write-up (paper/lambda4-proof.md). The proof re-runs in one command: node tools/run-lambda4-campaign.js. Machine-derived with Claude (Anthropic) driving certified-arithmetic instruments; the statement, strategy, and core lemmas are Mercer's. NOT peer-reviewed; refutations and independent re-verifications are invited.
